@@ -0,0 +1,97 @@
+import mongoose from "mongoose";
+import { Schema } from 'mongoose';
+
+const chapterSchema = new Schema({
+title: {
+    type: String,
+    required: true,
+  },
+
+  duration: {
+    type: String,
+    required: true,
+  },
+
+  progress: {
+    type: Number, 
+    default: 0, 
+  },
+
+  bookAudio: {
+      type: String,
+      required: true,
+    }
+});
+
+
+const bookSchema = new Schema({
+  bookCover: {
+      type: String,
+      required: true,
+},
+
+  bookName: {
+    type: String,
+    required: true,
+    unique: true,
+  },
+
+  bookDescription: {
+    type: String,
+    required: true,
+    unique:true
+  },
+
+  bookAuthor: {
+    type: String,
+    required: true,
+  },
+
+  reciter: {
+    type: String,
+    required: true,
+  },
+
+  status: {
+    type: String,
+    enum: ['isCertified', 'notCertified'],
+    default: 'notCertified',
+    required: true
+  },  
+
+  chapters: [chapterSchema], 
+
+  listenersList: [{ 
+    type: [mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId],
+    default: [],
+    ref: 'User' 
+  }],
+
+  listenersCount: {
+    type: Number,
+    default: 0,
+  },
+
+  category: {
+    type: String,
+    required: true,
+    enum: ['History & Biographies', 'Fiction', 'Romance', 'Kids', 'Personal Development', 'Adventure & Thrillers']
+  },
+
+  language: {
+    type: String,
+    required: true,
+    enum: ['Swahili', 'Yoruba', 'Zulu', 'Amharic', 'Hausa', 'Igbo', 'Amazigh', 'Shona', 'Fulani', 'Malagasy', 'Oromo']
+  }, 
+  
+  postedBy:{
+      type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
+      ref: 'User', 
+      // required: true,
+       },
+},
+  { timestamps: true }
+);
+
+const Book = mongoose.models.Book || mongoose.model('Book', bookSchema);
+export default Book;
